input_prompt: Design a stealth game with: 5 ninja clans, shadow mechanics, parkour, gadget crafting, detection system, boss fights, replay missions

rules.name: Stealth Mechanics
rules.description: Players must navigate undetected through levels, using shadows and parkour to evade detection.

rules.name: Gadget Crafting
rules.description: Players can craft gadgets using blueprints and resources, which can aid in stealth and combat.

rules.name: Detection System
rules.description: Enemies have a detection system that can spot players, triggering alarms and alerting other enemies.

rules.name: Boss Fights
rules.description: Players must face off against powerful bosses, using strategy and gadgets to emerge victorious.

rules.name: Replay Missions
rules.description: Players can replay levels to improve their score and try different approaches.

interactions.result: Gadget is used to aid in stealth or combat
Alarm is triggered, alerting other enemies
Player earns rewards and progresses through the game

implementation_steps: Implement stealth mechanics using shadows and detection system
Create parkour system using animations and level environments
Develop gadget crafting system using blueprints and resources
Implement combat system using enemy AI and player combat mechanics
Create UI system using UI assets and player inventory
